sections.title: Special Topics: Gambling on Innovation
sections.description: This course will be offered when necessitated by demand and permitted by schedule. The topics covered by the course will vary depending on the particular interests and expertise of the instructor(s). Topics are generally subjects of contemporary concern in the discipline.
